name: Kodi Vepudu
subtitle: chicken fried dry with curry leaves and pepper until the masala clings to the bone

ingredients.note: small pieces, this is eaten with fingers
crushed, not powdered, you want to meet it

prepNotes: Vepudu means fry. There is no gravy at the end and there should not be.
Rub the chicken with the turmeric and salt and refrigerate 20 minutes while you slice the onion.

steps.text: Heat the oil, splutter the dried chillies and one sprig of curry leaves, then add the onion and fry until golden.
Add the ginger and garlic pastes, cook 2 minutes, then the chicken and chilli powder. Fry on high 5 minutes.
Cover and cook 15 minutes on low. The chicken releases its own water and cooks in it.
steps.tip: No added water at any point.

steps.text: Uncover, raise the heat and fry until every drop has gone and the masala is stuck to the meat, about 10 minutes.
steps.tip: This is the whole dish. Stop too early and it is a curry.

steps.text: Add the crushed pepper and the remaining curry leaves, toss 2 minutes, and serve.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. Reheat dry in a pan rather than a microwave, which softens the crust you just built.
